2. Definitions. In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in
the subject or context,‑
"prescribed" means
prescribed by rules made under this Act;
"Reserves" means the
Reserves of the Pakistan Army or of the (The original word "Royal" omitted by A. O.1961,
Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* Pakistan Air Force;
"reservist" means a
member of the Reserves.

3. Divisions of Reserve Forces.‑(1) The Reserves shall consist
of the categories specified
in the Schedule to this Act.
(2) The Central Government may,
by notification in the official Gazette, add to, amend or vary the Schedule to
this Act.

Liability of reservists to military or air force law

THE PAKISTAN (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) RESERVES ACT, 1950

[19th April, 1950]
An Act to provide for the constitution and discipline of the Pakis tan

4. Liability of reservists to military or air force law. An Army
reservist shall be subject to the Indian Army Act, 1911 (Ins. by Ordinance 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd
Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955).) [or the Pakistan Army Act, 1952] and the rules and regulations
made thereunder and an Air Force reservist shall be subject to the Indian Air
Force Act, 1932 (Ins. by Ordinance 21 of 1960, s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect
from the 14th October, 1955).)
[or the Pakistan Air Force Act, 1953,] and the rules and regulations made
thereunder, in such manner and to such extent as may be prescribed VIII of
1911, XXXIX of 1952 XIV of 1932, VI of 1953.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Army and Air Force Reserves 1950
sections.description:
Power to make rules

THE PAKISTAN (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) RESERVES ACT, 1950
THE PAKISTAN (ARMY AND AIR FORCE) RESERVES ACT, 1950
ACT No. XLVII of 1950
[19th April, 1950]
An Act to provide for the constitution and discipline of the Pakis tan
Army and Air Force Reserves
6. Power to make rules.‑(1) The Central Government may make
rules(For
the Pakistan Air Force Reserves Rules, 1950, see Gaz. of P., 1951, Pt. I, pp.
163‑164‑ For the Pakistan Army Reserves Rules 1953, see ibid.,
1953, Pt. IIII, pp. 55‑61.)
to carry out the purposes of this Act.
(2) In particular and without
prejudice to the generality of the foregoing power, such rules may‑
(a) provide for the constitution
of, and the appoint ment or transfer of any personas a reservist to, the
reserves;
(b) prescribe the service
obligations to which reservists shall be liable;
(c) prescribe periodical training
for any category of reservists;
(d) provide for and regulate the
pay and allowances of reservists;
(e) prescribe the authorities by
whom and the con ditions subject to which the services of reservists may be
terminated;
(f) provide for and regulate the
gratuities or com pensation, if any, to be paid to reservists or any category
of reservists, or to any dependents of reservists; and
(g) provide for any other matter
which under this Act is to be or may be prescribed.
(3) All rules made under this Act
shall be published in the official Gazette and on such publication shall have
effect as if enacted in this Act.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Army and Air Force Reserves 1950

Power to make regulations

ACT No. XLVII of 1950
[19th April, 1950]
An Act to provide for the constitution and discipline of the Pakis tan
Army and Air Force Reserves
7. Power to make regulations. In the case of Army reservists, the
Commander‑in -Chief of the Pakistan Army, and in the case of Air Force
reser vists, the (Subs. by A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Air Officer
Commanding- in‑Chief of the Royal Pakistan Air Force" (with effect
from the 23rd March, 1956).)[Commander‑in‑Chief
of the Pakistan Air Force], may make regulations not inconsistent with this Act
and rules made thereunder, providing generally for all details connected with
the training, clothing, equipment and leave of reservists.
